matching: Items 1-2 write the opposite of a given adjective in context; 3-4 three-option choice of opposite; EC = Arabic-L1 opposite formed by 'not' or a wrong lexical opposite ('not big' -> small, 'short' for 'old'... ) in a sentence; FP = one sentence using a given opposite pair word; transfer = description of two objects. Adjective pairs EVP A1, one pair per item, prompts 8-13 words. Item order identical across forms: 1-2 controlled gap-fill, 3-4 controlled choice, 5-6 error correction, 7-8 free production (target_form_0_1_2), 9 transfer. Review round 1: slot 5 now uses the Arabic-L1 polysemy errors long/tall and big/old. Re-review round 2: slot 5 keys are two sentences (no comma splice); C-5 now in the L1 direction (long for tall); A-5 no longer repeats appearance A-6.
